consent.title: Before we process your photo
consent.lead: This step processes a photo of you. Nothing leaves your device until you agree below.
consent.point_what: What we process: the photo you select, downscaled and re-encoded in your browser.
consent.point_why: Why: to render the virtual try-on, match the garment, or tag your wardrobe piece.
consent.point_where: Where: sent over HTTPS to the CONFIT API and, for try-on, to the configured GPU render worker.
consent.point_retention: Retention: anonymous try-on jobs and their photos expire automatically after {{hours}} hours. You can delete a job at any time from the studio.
consent.point_training: We never use your photos to train models unless you opt in separately.
consent.point_no_biometric_id: We do not run face recognition and do not uniquely identify you from a photo.
consent.remember: Remember my choice for this session
consent.granted: Consent recorded — you can withdraw it at any time.
consent.withdrawn: Consent withdrawn. No photo will be processed.
consent.required_hint: Photo processing is optional. You can use the no-photo Fit Finder instead.
consent.on_device_note: Downscaling and re-encoding happen locally in your browser before anything is sent.
consent.purpose_try_on: Purpose: render the virtual try-on of the garment you selected on your own photo.
consent.purpose_visual_search: Purpose: match the garment in your photo against the CONFIT catalogue.
consent.purpose_wardrobe: Purpose: store the garment photos you upload in your wardrobe so you can find and re-use them.
consent.purpose_body_scan: Purpose: estimate your body measurements from the inputs you provide, to recommend a size.
consent.retention_try_on: Retention: the anonymised try-on job and its photo expire automatically after {{hours}} hours, and you can delete the job sooner from the studio.
consent.retention_visual_search: Retention: the search photo is processed to return matches and is not saved to your wardrobe.
consent.retention_wardrobe: Retention: wardrobe photos are kept until you delete that item; deleting the item deletes its image.
consent.retention_body_scan: Retention: the anonymised measurement session and its photo expire automatically after {{hours}} hours.
consent.manage_lead: You can withdraw any of these at any time. Withdrawing stops the next processing; it does not delete photos you already chose to keep in your wardrobe — delete those items from your wardrobe to remove them.
consent.manage_empty: You have not granted consent for any photo processing yet. The try-on, visual search, wardrobe upload and body scan flows each ask separately before a photo is processed.
consent.manage_scope_note: This record is stored in your browser. It is what the app checks before processing a photo.

legal.scope: Applies to confit-a.vercel.app and its API
legal.contact_in_app: In-app: Profile → Privacy → export or erase your data without emailing us.
legal.privacy_subtitle: What CONFIT collects, why, how long it is kept, and who it is shared with. Written to describe the system as it actually behaves today.
legal.privacy_account: Account data: email, name, optional phone, password (bcrypt-hashed — never readable by us), role, language preference.
legal.privacy_style: Style profile: the style and onboarding answers you give to personalize recommendations.
legal.privacy_measurements: Measurements: body measurements you enter in the Fit Finder or derive from the camera scan. They are processed to compute size recommendations. They are only persisted when you explicitly press “Save these measurements to my profile”.
legal.privacy_photos: Try-on photos: photos you upload to Virtual Try-On, processed to render the garment on your image. Anonymous try-on jobs are auto-expired after {{hours}} hours. You can trigger deletion at any time from the studio.
legal.privacy_wardrobe: Wardrobe items: garment photos and attributes you upload to your Smart Wardrobe.
legal.privacy_commerce: Commerce data: cart, orders, returns, promotions. Orders placed in Demo Payment Mode contain a demo payment marker and no real card data ever reaches CONFIT.
legal.privacy_logs: Technical logs: request logs including IP and user-agent for security and rate limiting.
legal.privacy_not_sell: We do not sell personal data.
legal.privacy_not_train: We do not use your try-on photos to train models without a separate explicit opt-in.
legal.privacy_not_store_card: We do not store readable passwords or full card numbers. In demo mode no card data is collected at all.
legal.privacy_cookies_body: Authentication uses an httpOnly session cookie plus a readable CSRF token for double-submit protection. Guests get a random session token in local storage so carts and measurement sessions work without an account. Language and cart preferences are stored locally in your browser.
legal.privacy_retention_until_delete: Until you delete them or erase your account
legal.privacy_processors_hosting: Hosting: Vercel (application and serverless API) and Neon (PostgreSQL database, EU region endpoint).
legal.privacy_processors_ai: AI providers: styling and vision features may call configured AI APIs with the minimum payload needed for the feature. When a provider is not configured the feature degrades honestly instead of shipping your data elsewhere.
legal.privacy_processors_payments: Payments: currently a simulated adapter (Demo Payment Mode). No payment data leaves CONFIT until a payment service provider is connected and this policy is updated.
legal.privacy_ctrl_export: Export everything: Profile → Privacy → Export my data (machine-readable JSON).
legal.privacy_ctrl_erase: Erase everything: Profile → Privacy → Delete account — irrevocable removal of profile, measurements, wardrobe and photos.
legal.privacy_ctrl_delete_items: Delete individual try-on jobs and wardrobe items at any time from their screens.
legal.terms_subtitle: The agreement between you and CONFIT when you use the storefront, the styling tools, or the brand portal.
legal.terms_acceptance_body: By using CONFIT you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
legal.terms_h2: 2. The service today — honest capability statement
legal.terms_cap_live: Catalog, search, outfit building, fit recommendations, wardrobe and demo checkout are live features.
legal.terms_cap_demo_payments: Payments are in Demo Payment Mode: checkout uses a simulated payment adapter; orders are labelled as demo and no real charge is made and no goods are shipped. Live payment requires an explicit “payments live” deployment with a connected payment service provider.
legal.terms_cap_vton: Virtual Try-On renders only when a GPU inference worker is configured; when it is not, the feature shows an explicit unavailability state instead of a fabricated result.
legal.terms_cap_ai: AI styling answers are generated and can be wrong. Fit recommendations are decision support, not a guarantee of physical fit.
legal.terms_acc_creds: You are responsible for your credentials and activity under your account.
legal.terms_acc_roles: One person per account. Consumer accounts cannot self-elevate to brand or admin roles — roles are granted server-side.
legal.terms_acc_suspend: We may suspend accounts that abuse the platform (scraping, fraud attempts, rate-limit evasion, uploading unlawful imagery).
legal.terms_photos_body: Only upload photos of yourself or photos you have the right to use. No photos of minors in try-on, no impersonation, no unlawful content. Uploaded photos are processed only to render your try-on or tag your wardrobe.
legal.terms_h5: 5. Purchases, orders and returns (when payments are live)
legal.terms_purch_pricing: Prices, tax and shipping are computed server-side at checkout.
legal.terms_purch_stock: Stock is reserved during checkout; order confirmation is authoritative from the server, not from the UI.
legal.terms_purch_returns: The return window is {{days}} days unless a brand’s policy states otherwise on the product page.
legal.terms_purch_demo: In Demo Payment Mode, “placed” orders are test artifacts and carry no payment obligation.
legal.terms_brands_body: Brand portal accounts may manage only their own brand’s catalog, inventory and analytics (tenant isolation is enforced server-side). Import tooling must not be used to upload unlawful or infringing content; sample imports are clearly labelled and never presented as live inventory.
legal.terms_liability_body: The service is provided “as is”. To the maximum extent permitted by law, CONFIT is not liable for indirect or consequential damages. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law.
legal.terms_changes_body: We may update these terms. Material changes are announced in-app with a new version number and “Last updated” date above, and are recorded in the change log below.
legal.gdpr_subtitle: How CONFIT implements GDPR rights for EU/EEA users — with the in-product controls that exercise each right.
legal.gdpr_controller_body: CONFIT (operated by the project owner) is the controller for the personal data described in the Privacy Policy. Contact: {{contact}}.
legal.gdpr_basis_consent_per_upload: Consent — explicit, per upload; retention consent optional
legal.gdpr_h3: 3. Your rights and where to exercise them in the product
legal.gdpr_right_access: Access and portability: Profile → Privacy → Export my data — a structured JSON download, authenticated and rate-limited.
legal.gdpr_right_erasure: Erasure: Profile → Privacy → Delete account — erases profile, measurements, wardrobe, photos and revokes sessions. Irrevocable.
legal.gdpr_right_rectification: Rectification: edit your name, phone, language and style profile directly in Profile.
legal.gdpr_right_objection: Objection and withdrawal of consent: delete individual try-on jobs or wardrobe items; declining “Save measurements” keeps processing ephemeral.
legal.gdpr_right_complaint: Complaint: you may lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority.
legal.gdpr_biometric_body: Body measurements and try-on photos can be sensitive. CONFIT processes them only on explicit action: photos are used to render your try-on and anonymous jobs expire automatically after {{hours}} hours; measurements persist only after an explicit save. Account deletion removes the encrypted biometric store. We do not perform face recognition and do not uniquely identify individuals from photos.
legal.gdpr_transfers_body: Primary hosting and the database endpoint are in the EU region. AI provider calls, when configured, may process payloads outside the EEA under the provider’s transfer safeguards; when a provider is not configured the feature degrades rather than transferring data.
legal.gdpr_breach_body: Confirmed personal-data breaches affecting your rights are reported to the competent supervisory authority within 72 hours and to affected users without undue delay.
legal.contact_not_configured: This deployment has not configured a data-protection mailbox.
legal.gdpr_controller_body_no_contact: CONFIT (operated by the project owner) is the controller for the personal data described in the Privacy Policy. This deployment has not published a data-protection mailbox; use the in-app controls below, which produce a verifiable, dated record.
legal.changelog_v4: Full Arabic translation of every legal clause; version and change log made explicit; the unverified controller mailbox removed; the unsupported biometric-capture claim withdrawn because no biometric computation runs in this product.
legal.changelog_v3: Rewritten to describe the system as it actually behaves: demo payment mode, honest try-on unavailability, real export and erasure endpoints.
